goal: Review how secrets are stored, rotated, passed to code and kept out of logs and source.
use: Review how secrets are stored, rotated, passed to code and kept out of logs and source. Use when keys, tokens or passwords are added or moved.

steps.note: Find the secrets. List API keys, tokens, passwords and certificates the code uses, and where each one is read.
Check the source. Flag secrets in source files, configuration, examples and test fixtures.
Check storage. Secrets belong in a secret store or the environment, not in files that are committed.
Check logs and errors. Flag secrets written to logs, error messages, URLs or analytics.
Check rotation. Each secret needs a way to rotate without a code change.
Report. List each finding with its location, severity and the fix.

protocol.title: Check rotation
protocol.text: Each secret needs a way to rotate without a code change. Flag secrets that can never change.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: List each finding with its location, severity and the fix. Treat any secret found in source as exposed, and say so.
